candidates.statement: Inventory's redis.reserve_inventory calls time out (1650ms, ERROR), producing 12 redis_operation_timeout 504 errors and 27 dependency timeouts; inventory p95 rises to 1080ms, propagating latency/errors to gateway's inventory call (1951ms, ERROR).
candidates.uncertainty: Redis-side telemetry absent; timeout cause (redis saturation vs network) not established. Inventory error_rate metric is low (0.0012), conflicting with 12 logged errors.

report.explanation: Current telemetry localizes the fault to inventory's redis dependency: error spans and 504 redis_operation_timeout logs with elevated dependency timeouts and p95, propagating to gateway. Deployment record alone cannot establish causation. Redis-side evidence is missing to confirm the underlying cause.
